fields.shutdowns.*: event, event_date, group, id, name, status, alternatives, citations, date_precision, history_reviewed_on, kingy_page, latest_source_recheck, sources, summary
fields.deadlines.*: id, name, provider, date, precision, certainty, scope, action, replacement, source, recordUrl, reviewedAt, checkedAt, revision, status, confirmedRetired, sourceCurrent, needsReview, reviewReason, history, origin, fingerprint, model_id, aliases, vendor, route, dateType, date_qualifier, lastVerified, checkAnchor, checkText, evidenceSnapshot, evidenceSha256, sourceFetchedAt, replacementConflict, supportingSources, source_license, model_ids, sourceEvidence, sourceProjection, manualReview, minimumLifetime, deprecatedAt, reviewStatus, autoCheck, modelVersion, behaviorSource, announcedAt, legacyAt, publicExtendedAccessAt

route_contract: Each id names one catalog notice; model IDs can recur on separate routes and versions. No cloud/direct record merge.
date_contract: date is YYYY-MM-DD or null; preserve precision, certainty, dateType, date_qualifier and minimumLifetime separately.
sync_contract: Scheduled mirror of the reviewed AI Deadlines catalog. Preserve source record-change dates and every review hold; no-op runs do not rewrite dataset files.
